title: Dataset-card pretext jailbreak frame in an LLM gateway prompt -- T1027
author: WRG-11
description:
Detects the dataset-card pretext jailbreak framing publicly demonstrated by
Pliny the Liberator (@elder_plinius) against Google Gemini 3.5 Flash in May
2026. In the published autonomous jailbreaking run, a restricted request
was framed as filling in example records for an open-source HuggingFace
dataset card for a detection benchmark, and the model went on to produce
content beyond the initial request.

The rule matches the framing, not any restricted payload: an LLM gateway or
AI-proxy prompt that combines a HuggingFace dataset-card or model-card
structure with reviewer or placeholder pretext markers asking the model to
complete canonical example content.

The escalation observed in the run is behavioural, so pair this per-prompt
rule with a session-level breadth metric. LLM gateway prompt logging is not
yet standard SOC telemetry; bind the field names to your AI-proxy log
schema before deployment.
